automation.notes:
Use button: consume it for Dark Energon. Automatic: while you hold at least 1 Dark Energon, +1 Toughness and Evasion on the sheet and ↑1 on Strength and Speed Skill Tests, labelled Dark Energon (held) in the Roll Options Dialog. A switch there spends it for Edge.

Chat card: after a Strength or Speed Skill Test, a Dark Energon reroll button spends 1 point to reroll the dice.

Every use (consuming, the Edge, the reroll) adds to an addiction check that can give you Addicted, and feeds an addict's craving for the day.
